note: Structural contract for PatientAgentBench run directories read by scripts/validate_pab_contract.py. This file is the engine's own declaration of what it requires from a transcript; it is not a copy of any PatientAgentBench data structure, and the engine never imports that project's code (license boundary: their code is CC-BY-NC-4.0, this repo is MIT, and reading JSON output is not a derivative work).

arm_spec.note: Encoding of the arm label carried in the transcript's personality field. Written by the fork-side adapter (src/patientwords_pab/trait_spec.py); the grammar is duplicated here on purpose rather than imported, so this repo stays free of the fork's license. Keep the two in step by hand: the pinned forms are covered by tests/test_validate_pab_contract.py.
